hooks.name: transform-safety-review
hooks.description: When the agent finishes, review its changes against the Zero Breaking Logic and web security steering.

action.prompt: Review the files changed in this session under src/ and web/. Check every changed code rewrite rule against .kiro/steering/zero-breaking-logic.md, and every changed web file against .kiro/steering/web-security.md. List each violation with file and line, and any new rewrite rule that lacks a side-by-side case in test/zero-breaking-logic.test.js. If nothing under src/ or web/ changed, or everything complies, answer only "Zero Breaking Logic: OK".
